review_steps.prompt_notification: Step 1/6: Speak today's core focus word or overarching theme.
review_steps.structure_prompt:
Extract the single core focus word or theme from this voice note. Output only the word or short phrase, nothing else:
{raw_text}

review_steps.prompt_notification: Step 2/6: What did you accomplish, build, or unblock today?
review_steps.structure_prompt:
Convert this voice note into a concise bullet-point list of achievements. Each bullet must start with a past-tense action verb. Output only the bullet points, no headings:
{raw_text}

review_steps.prompt_notification: Step 3/6: What tasks need immediate attention tomorrow?
review_steps.structure_prompt:
Convert this voice note into a Markdown checkbox task list for tomorrow. Format each item as '- [ ] task description'. Output only the checkbox list, no headings:
{raw_text}

review_steps.prompt_notification: Step 4/6: Any wellness or personal reflections? (Speak or Skip).
Step 5/6: Summarise today's meetings — decisions made and actions assigned.
review_steps.structure_prompt:
Summarise this meeting note into structured bullet points. Group under two sub-sections labelled 'Decisions:' and 'Actions:'. Output only the bullet points:
{raw_text}

review_steps.prompt_notification: Step 6/6: Any movement, exercise, or physical activity today?
review_steps.structure_prompt:
Summarise this movement or physical activity note in 1-2 plain sentences:
{raw_text}
